title: HDLC Frame vs. LLC and MAC Frames
markdown:
The IEEE 802 LLC/MAC frame structure is derived from the HDLC frame.

An **HDLC frame** has: Address, Control, Upper-layer data, FCS.

{{viz:0}}

This one HDLC frame maps onto **two** IEEE 802 frames:

- The **LLC PDU** carries: DSAP (Destination Service Access Point),
  SSAP (Source Service Access Point), Control, and Upper-layer data —
  corresponding to the HDLC frame's Address/Control/data portion.
- The **MAC frame** carries: MAC header, MAC payload, FCS — the LLC PDU
  is encapsulated as the MAC payload.

**DSAP** = Destination service access point. **SSAP** = Source service
access point.
